question_en:
I am the video editor for a commemorative exhibition at a sports arena and need to create national opening titles for all delegations shown in the image. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which event and which edition does the image correspond to?
2. Before the edition shown in the image, had the countries of the delegations in the image ever hosted this event? For those that have, list all previous host cities and years; for those that have not, explicitly write "Never hosted". Provide a complete list covering all delegations in the image, with each line stating the delegation, whether it has ever hosted, and the corresponding host cities and years; then list all delegations requiring the addition of archival host footage and their count.

The answer must first state the event name and edition for Question 1, then use a table with the format "Delegation—Whether Previously Hosted—Host Cities and Years" to answer Question 2, followed by a list after the table of the delegations requiring archival host footage and their count.
answer:
1. 2025 World Athletics Championships in Tokyo (Tokyo 2025, the 20th World Athletics Championships).

2.

| Delegation | Whether Previously Hosted | Host Cities and Years |
| --- | --- | --- |
| United States | Previously hosted | Eugene 2022 |
| Kenya | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Canada | Previously hosted | Edmonton 2001 |
| Netherlands | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Botswana | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Spain | Previously hosted | Seville 1999 |
| New Zealand | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Sweden | Previously hosted | Gothenburg 1995 |
| Portugal | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Jamaica | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Italy | Previously hosted | Rome 1987 |
| Germany | Previously hosted | Stuttgart 1993, Berlin 2009 |
| Brazil | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Trinidad and Tobago | Never hosted | Never hosted |
| Australia | Never hosted | Never hosted |

Delegations requiring the addition of archival host footage: United States, Canada, Spain, Sweden, Italy, Germany, totaling 6 teams.
